CustomField.description: How complete this task's relationship (dependency) extraction was. Complete = everything this scanner supports was extracted. Partial = a permanent, by-design boundary on what this scanner covers. Degraded = this run could not extract what it normally would, and may succeed after a permission or configuration change.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Complete, Partial, or Degraded. Partial is a known product boundary; Degraded is situational and may be fixable.
CustomField.label: Coverage Status
